locator_policy: store page, printed page, source section and source object as separate atomic fields; never serialize a composite locator
source_text_policy: preserve source-native lexical text after NFC and whitespace collapse only; do not translate, summarize, expand, recase or repunctuate
semantic_policy: store controlled codes separately from source-native labels and quotations
time_basis_policy: calendar or working requires explicit source clock wording; a year, financial year, annual label or numeric period alone does not establish a clock and resolves to unknown
date_policy: populate an ISO date only from exact-edition or prospectively packet-bound calendar evidence; otherwise use null with not_stated provenance
